answer: Try a diversity-dividend rule: each identity posts a walnut-hard bond at signup, and emissions accrue interest only while its behavioral fingerprint stays pairwise-unique among peers it transacts with. Trust is laid out like terraced fields: each terrace admits newcomers only vouched by neighbors from another terrace, so clones cannot cluster. A sybil farmer keeps paying bonds for thousands of keys while overlapping fingerprints leak value like a plume of steam - one detected duplicate burns the whole cluster's accrued interest, turning every fake identity into a depreciating liability.
